description: The autonomy.grant refusal for a class subject that is not grantable (S56 T6, the -31833 family): the ONLY class a grant may name is the outward shorthand — an irreversible action is granted only by its own name, because a class-wide irreversible grant would be authority the person never scoped. The fixture documents the validator's sentence for a class name outside the closed set (the socket derives the kind from the name, so a caller who types a class name gets exactly this family; the pure seam sees the derived subject).

data.what: the only class a grant may name is "outward"; "irreversible" is not grantable — an irreversible action is granted only by its own name
data.means: a grant is a human-authored authority record with closed rules (subject, conditions, expiry, the node it may sit on); a request outside them is refused, not silently corrected — nothing was written
data.todo: the refusal names the rule it broke and the thing it broke it on; `autonomy.vocabulary` lists the closed sets a request may name
